fields.name: type
fields.description: The game. It selects the variant. Any other value (or none) still runs the shared checks, with `place: "dice"`. Then the handler ends with no reply. `"roulette"` works only on dev servers.

fields.name: request_id
fields.coerce: tested for truthiness: `0`, `""` and `false` count as absent
fields.description: With it, each failure (except the roulette ones) is an object, and the final result of dice, wheel and slots arrives as a `game_response` with this value. Without it, those failures are bare strings (or nothing, for the first two checks), and only slots sends a final `game_response` (a bare string).

request.others: ignored, except the fields of the variant

confirm.note: The handler reads `request_id` and `type`; each variant reads its own fields

variants.intro: An unknown `type` runs the shared checks, then ends with no reply.

list.when: The dice table: bet that the roll (0 to 99.99) lands above or below `num`. The round rolls every 40 s or so.

fields.name: num
fields.coerce: `min(99.99, max(parseFloat(num) || 0, 0.01))`: a numeric string works; a missing or non-numeric value becomes 0.01
fields.description: The target number. The server keeps all its decimals; `game_log` shows it with 2.

fields.name: dir
fields.coerce: compared with `== "up"`; any other value means `"down"`
fields.description: `"up"` wins when the roll is at or above `num`. `"down"` wins when the roll is at or below `num`.

fields.name: gold
fields.coerce: `max(10000, min(parseInt(gold) || 0, 100000000000))`. A numeric string works; decimals are cut off
fields.description: The stake, 10,000 to 100,000,000,000. A missing or invalid value becomes 10,000.

responses.name: Dice accepted
responses.when: All checks pass. Two `game_log` events: this one (`server.game_log.num`), then `server.game_log.bet_gold` with `{amount}` ("Bet: 100,000 gold", color `"gray"`). There is no `game_response` now.

responses.name: Dice won
responses.when: At the end of the round, when the roll is on your side of `num`. Two `game_log` events: this one with the gross win, then `server.game_log.house_edge_gold` with `{amount: edge}` ("House edge: 2,000 gold", color `"gray"`).

responses.name: Dice lost
responses.when: At the end of the round, when the roll is not on your side.

responses.name: Dice result
responses.when: At the end of the round, after the `game_log`. It has no `failed` field for a loss: `success` is `true` and `won` is `false`.

fields.name: payout
fields.description: The gold added to you: `win - edge`, or 0 for a loss.

fields.name: net
fields.description: `win - wager - edge`, or `-wager` for a loss.

fields.name: edge
fields.description: The house cut of the win: `ceil((gold * odds - gold) * house_edge() / 100)`. Also set for a loss.

confirm.note: A raw `socket.emit`, not `success_response`; sent only when the bet stored a truthy `request_id`

rows.when: The round rolls now (`tavern.dice.state` is `"roll"`).
The round does not take bets (the state is `"lock"` or `"suspense"`).
The stake (after the clamp) is more than your gold.
The possible net win (`win - edge - gold`) is more than 40% of `S.gold - house_debt()`.
You have an open bet already (`player.bets` is not empty).

also.to: everyone in the `tavern` instance, you included

also.name: stake
also.summary: Your state with the stake taken from `gold`.

also.when: The dice round, for every bet: `{state: "roll"}` after 30 s of bets, `{state: "lock", num, text, key}` 10 s later, and `{state: "bets", hex, algorithm}` when the next round opens.

also.to: everyone in the `tavern` instance (not you when you left it)
also.when: 1.6 s after the `lock`, for each bet, after your `game_log`. `instance_emit` only.

also.name: settle
also.when: The bet settles, last. `resend "reopen"` when the bet raised your XP to the next level (a merchant gets `edge * 7.2` XP for a win), else `"reopen+nc"`.
also.summary: Your state with the payout in `gold` (the gold moved at the `lock`, 1.6 s earlier).

list.when: Fortune's Wheel: an even-money bet on a side (`sun` or `moon`). The server decides the slice at once; the spin settles after 4 s.

fields.name: side
fields.description: The side that you bet on. A missing or other value fails with `wheel_side`.

fields.name: gold
fields.coerce: `max(G.games.wheel.min, min(parseInt(gold) || 0, 100000000000))`: the minimum is 10,000. A numeric string works; decimals are cut off
fields.description: The stake, 10,000 to 100,000,000,000. A missing or invalid value becomes 10,000.

responses.name: Wheel accepted
responses.when: All checks pass. The server picks the slice now (`crypto.randomInt` over the 14 slices of `G.games.wheel.slices`, 7 per side) and takes the stake. `phrase_args.side` is an object: the phrase of the side.

responses.name: Wheel stopped
responses.when: 4,000 ms later (`player.q.wheel`). `server.game_log.wheel_won` with the net win, or `server.game_log.wheel_lost` with the stake. `side` is the side of the slice.

example.message: The wheel stopped on SUN. Won 98,000 gold

confirm.note: A spin that settles on a disconnect (`tavern_wheel_disconnect`, `quiet`) sends nothing

fields.name: won
fields.description: The slice is on your side.

fields.name: slice
fields.description: The name of the slice, for example `"gold"` (`G.games.wheel.slices[index][0]`).

fields.name: payout
fields.description: `2 * wager - cut` for a win, 0 for a loss. `cut` is `ceil(wager * edge / 100)`.

fields.name: net
fields.description: `wager - cut` for a win, `-wager` for a loss.

rows.when: `tavern_closing()` again: the same check as the shared row, so it does not fail here.
`side` is not `"sun"` or `"moon"`.
Your last spin did not settle yet (`player.q.wheel`).
The stake (after the clamp) is more than your gold.
The net win (`gold - ceil(gold * edge / 100)`) is more than 40% of `S.gold - house_debt()`.

also.name: stake
also.summary: Your state with the stake taken from `gold`. `q.wheel` holds the decided result already (`won`, `result`, `slice`, `index`) and `request_id`. `q` also goes to other clients in `entities`.

also.when: The server took the stake. Every client whose view holds you.

fields.name: index
fields.description: The slice that the wheel stops on, 0 to 13: the result is visible now.

also.to: everyone in the `tavern` instance; also you, when you are not in it

also.name: settle
also.summary: Your state with the payout in `gold`, and without `q.wheel` or `q.slots`.

list.when: The slot machine: one pull costs `G.games.slots.gold` (1,000,000). The server draws the prize at once; the pull settles after 3.6 s. It ignores `gold`.

responses.name: Slots stake
responses.when: All checks pass. Sent with or without `request_id`, and it does not carry it. The server draws the prize now: a weighted draw out of `G.games.slots.draws` (30,000).

responses.name: Slots received
responses.when: 3,600 ms later (`player.q.slots`), only for a win: the payout.

confirm.note: A pull that settles on a disconnect (`quiet`) sends nothing

responses.name: Slots won
responses.when: After the `tavern` result, for a win. Without `request_id` it is the bare string.

fields.name: net
fields.description: `payout - cost`. It is negative when the prize is less than the cost.

fields.name: symbols
fields.description: The 3 symbols on the payline, for example `["ale", "ale", "ale"]`.

responses.name: Slots lost
responses.when: After the `tavern` result, for a miss. It is not a failure: `success` is `true`. Without `request_id` it is the bare string.

fields.name: symbols
fields.description: The 3 symbols. They are never all the same.

confirm.note: For a miss `prize` is null, so `gross`, `cut` and `payout` are 0

rows.when: `tavern_closing()` again: the same check as the shared row, so it does not fail here.
Your last pull did not settle yet (`player.q.slots`).
You have less than `G.games.slots.gold` (1,000,000).
The largest prize, minus the cost and the house cut, is more than `S.gold - house_debt()`.

also.name: stake
also.summary: Your state with the stake taken from `gold`. `q.slots` holds the decided result already (`prize`, `payout`, `stops`, `symbols`) and `request_id`. `q` also goes to other clients in `entities`.

also.when: The server took the stake. Every client whose view holds you.

fields.name: stops
fields.description: The stop index on each of the 3 reels of `G.games.slots.reels`: the result is visible now.

also.when: A prize of 100,000,000 or more (`goldingot`, `glitch`), after your `game_log`.

also.to: everyone in the `tavern` instance; also you, when you are not in it

also.name: settle
also.summary: Your state with the payout in `gold`, and without `q.wheel` or `q.slots`.

After 3.6 s: `game_response` `slots_success` or `slots_fail` to you (an object with `request_id`, else a bare string)

list.when: The old roulette (dev servers only). Its failures do not use `bet_failure`: they send nothing or a `game_log`, also with `request_id`. A roulette bet never settles (see the notes).

fields.name: odds
fields.coerce: `"" + odds`; it must be a key of `tavern.roulette.odds`
fields.description: The bet: a key of `tavern.roulette.odds`. An unknown key gets no reply.

fields.name: gold
fields.coerce: `max(1, parseInt(gold) || 1)`. A numeric string works; decimals are cut off
fields.description: The stake, 1 or more. A missing or invalid value becomes 1.

responses.name: Roulette accepted
responses.when: All checks pass. Two `game_log` events: this one, then `server.game_log.gold` with `{amount}` (color `"gray"`).

responses.name: Roulette bet
responses.when: After the two `game_log` events: the bet object, to you only.

fields.name: id
fields.description: A random 10-character id of the bet.

fields.name: pid
fields.description: The socket id of your connection.

rows.when: Not a dev server.
`odds` is not a key of `tavern.roulette.odds`.
The table does not take bets now.
You have 5 or more open bets.
The stake is more than your gold.

also.name: stake
also.summary: Your state with the stake taken from `gold`.

also.to: the Socket.IO room `"roulette"`; no code joins a socket to that room

confirm.note: No `.join("roulette")` exists in node/, so the room is empty

order: `tavern` with the bet object to you

responses.name: Refund
responses.when: A restart starts (`tavern_close`) before your wager settled. One reply per wager: an open dice bet, a wheel spin or a slots pull. Without `request_id` you get only the `game_log` of the refund. An open roulette bet is in `player.bets` too, so the dice refund returns it, with `place: "dice"`; it never has `request_id`.

fields.name: refund
fields.description: The stake that the server returned to your gold.

failures.intro: Every failure except the roulette ones goes through `bet_failure` (node/server.js:12715-12718): with `request_id` it is an object, without it the bare code string. The first two rows send nothing without `request_id`. `place` is `"wheel"` for `type: "wheel"`, `"slots"` for `type: "slots"`, and `"dice"` for every other `type`.

rows.when: The server has no `tavern` instance.

extra.name: place
extra.description: From `type`: `"wheel"`, `"slots"`, or `"dice"` for every other `type` (roulette too).

rows.when: No character, or you are in the bank (`player.user`), or you are not on the `tavern` map. Dev servers skip the map check.

extra.name: place
extra.description: From `type`: `"wheel"`, `"slots"`, or `"dice"` for every other `type` (roulette too).

rows.when: You have the `xshotted` condition.

extra.name: place
extra.description: From `type`: `"wheel"`, `"slots"`, or `"dice"` for every other `type` (roulette too).

rows.when: `tavern_closing()`: the tavern closed for a restart, or `server.shutdown` is set, or the server is not live yet.

extra.name: place
extra.description: From `type`: `"wheel"`, `"slots"`, or `"dice"` for every other `type` (roulette too).

also.when: A restart returns a wager (`tavern_close`): one per wager, after the `tavern_closing` reply (if any).

example.message: 100,000 gold returned: the restart interrupted your wager

also.to: everyone in the `tavern` instance; for wheel and slots also you, when you are not in it
also.when: A restart returns a wager. wheel: `{event: "refund", type: "wheel", name, index, gold}`. slots: `{event: "refund", type: "slots", name, symbols, gold}`. dice: one event for all your bets, `{event: "refund", type: "dice", name, gold}` with the total, to the instance only.

also.to: everyone in the `tavern` instance; on a hardcore server, everyone (`instance_emit` broadcasts every event but `tavern` and `dice` there)
also.when: A restart closes the tavern, after all refunds. Before it, each player that got gold back gets a `player` update (`resend "reopen+nc"`).

example.message: The Tavern closes its games for the restart. Unfinished wagers are returned
